endorsements.quote: However, only the minimum required data within the scope of the intended purpose should be collected and utilized.

Furthermore, as the development of medical AI involves the processing of a substantial amount of sensitive private health-related information, obtaining appropriate legal approval for handling personal data and maintaining security is crucial.

unlisted_practices: Establish clear guidelines on patient privacy during data collection and on legal and moral responsibility for decisions made by AI.
Improve AI algorithm performance by training on more data collected from various healthcare facilities before actual implementation.

screen.reason: Editorial commentary discussing potential applications and governance/safety considerations of AI and ChatGPT in pain medicine.
